parameters.description: A five-digit post code, or its first digits, such as 026 for every code from 02600 to 02699.

get_company.description: Look up a Finnish company by its Business ID (Y-tunnus): its name, former and other names, street and postal address, company form, main line of business, website, whether it is on the Trade Register, in liquidation, bankrupt or in reorganisation, and whether it is registered for VAT, in the prepayment register and in the employer register. An ID no company holds comes back with 'found' set to false rather than failing the step.

mock_response.name: Nokia Oyj

registers.status: VAT-obliged for the transfer of rights to use immovable property

mock_response.summary: Nokia Oyj (0112038-9), public limited company, Espoo: on the Trade Register since 1896-12-19.

get_company.name: get_company

parameters.name: business_id

active.description: True while the company is registered on the Trade Register with a valid Business ID and has not ceased. A company in liquidation or bankruptcy can still be active; see those fields.

bankrupt.description: True while the company is in bankruptcy.

business_id_status.description: The Business ID's own status: Valid, Pending or Business ID invalidated.

business_line_classification.description: Which classification the code is from: 'TOL 2025' for current companies, 'TOL 2008' for many that ceased before 2026.

business_line_code.description: The main line of business as a TOL industry code, e.g. '70100'.

company_form.description: The company form in words, e.g. 'Public limited company'.

found.description: True when the register has a company with this Business ID. False means it has none, and every other detail is empty.

in_employer_register.description: True while the company is in the employer register (pays regular wages).

in_liquidation.description: True while the company is being wound up.

in_prepayment_register.description: True while the company is in the prepayment register, so customers need not withhold tax from what they pay it.

in_reorganisation.description: True while the company is in corporate restructuring (saneeraus).

in_trade_register.description: True while the company is registered on the Trade Register.

language.description: The language the words are in: en (English), fi (Finnish) or sv (Swedish).

last_modified.description: When PRH last changed the record, e.g. '2026-10-22T10:58:46'.

other_names.description: The company's other current names: parallel names in other languages and auxiliary (trading) names.

registered_on.description: When the name was registered, YYYY-MM-DD.

country.description: A two-letter country code, given for addresses abroad.

line.description: The whole address on one line, e.g. 'Karakaari 7, 02610 Espoo'.

municipality_code.description: Statistics Finland's three-digit municipality number, e.g. '049' for Espoo.

po_box.description: The PO box number, when the address is a PO box.

registered_on.description: When this address was registered, YYYY-MM-DD.

street.description: The street, number, staircase and flat, e.g. 'Karakaari 7'.

registers.description: Every register entry the company has had, current and ended: Trade Register, Tax Administration, prepayment, VAT and employer registers.

country.description: A two-letter country code, given for addresses abroad.

line.description: The whole address on one line, e.g. 'Karakaari 7, 02610 Espoo'.

municipality_code.description: Statistics Finland's three-digit municipality number, e.g. '049' for Espoo.

po_box.description: The PO box number, when the address is a PO box.

registered_on.description: When this address was registered, YYYY-MM-DD.

search_companies.description: Search the Finnish Trade Register's companies by name, town, company form, main line of business, post code, registration date or the date the Business ID was given. Use it to build a lead list ('software companies in Espoo'), to find the company behind a name, or to see who registered this week. Returns 100 companies a page, each with its Business ID for 'Get company'.

validate_business_id.description: Check that a Finnish Business ID (Y-tunnus) is well formed and its check digit is right, and get it written the standard way with the VAT number it gives. Nothing is sent to PRH, so it is instant; use 'Get company' to see whether a company holds it.

mock_response.summary: 0112038-9 is a valid Business ID (VAT number FI01120389).

validate_business_id.name: validate_business_id

parameters.description: The Business ID to check, written any common way: 0112038-9, 01120389 or the VAT number FI01120389.
parameters.name: business_id

business_id.description: The Business ID written the standard way, e.g. '0112038-9'; empty when not valid.

input.description: The text that was checked, as given.

reason.description: Why it is not valid, e.g. a wrong check digit; empty when valid.

summary.description: One readable line about the result.

valid.description: True when it is a well-formed Business ID with the right check digit. It does not say a company holds it; 'Get company' does.

vat_number.description: The EU VAT number it gives, e.g. 'FI01120389'; empty when not valid.

description: Look up any company on the Finnish Trade Register in the Business Information System (YTJ), kept by the Finnish Patent and Registration Office. Search companies by name, town, company form, line of business or registration date; read one by its Business ID (Y-tunnus) with its addresses, former names, status, liquidation or bankruptcy, and VAT, prepayment and employer registrations; list what has been registered for it; and validate a Business ID's check digit. No account or API key required.
